en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Les Ulmes
en.summary: A figure with crossed hands was reported to appear within an exposed Host during adoration.
en.body: During Eucharistic adoration on June 2, 1668, in Les Ulmes, France, a vision of a man in a white tunic with crossed hands was reported to appear within the exposed Host for about a quarter of an hour. The event is locally recognized.
